summary: PHASE 8 testing complete: Unified 24h Timeline + predictive TrajectoryLayer integration. All 53 backend tests pass (including new /api/storms/trajectory). Frontend Timeline scrubs over 24h, play/pause + reset-live work, WeatherLayersPanel shows 4 toggles (Nuages, Pluie, Vent, Trajet) with Trajet default ON, internal frame-slider hidden when timelineDriven. All regression endpoints still working.

issues: Recharts warnings 'width(-1) and height(-1) of chart should be greater than 0' on initial render - non-blocking, charts do render (170 chart elements found). Pre-existing issue from earlier iterations.

critical_code_review_comments: Timeline.jsx uses useEffect auto-advance loop that depends on cursorTs, recreating the interval every tick (400ms) – works but slightly wasteful. Low priority.

TrajectoryLayer.jsx calls /api/storms/trajectory every 30s regardless of timeline cursor – it always shows prediction anchored to live time, even when user scrubs back. If desired, wire cursorTs into trajectory fetch to reflect historical predictions. Product-level decision, not a bug.
analysis.predict_trajectory local import 'import math as _m' inside function body – minor code smell, could be moved to top of file.
context_for_next_testing_agent: PHASE 8 FEATURES VALIDATED: (1) Backend GET /api/storms/trajectory returns {detected, count, waypoints[], speed_kmh, bearing_deg, compass, eta_min, closest_distance_km}. When no strikes, returns {detected:false, reason:'not_enough_strikes', count:0} - this is correct PASS behavior. (2) /api/storms/approach, /api/forecast/storm-risk, /api/weather/* and /api/lightning/* all regressing clean. (3) Timeline (data-testid='timeline') renders at bottom of map with slider, play/pause, 24h range. Scrubbing changes badge from '● EN DIRECT' to '↺ REJEU · IL Y A X MIN' and shows 'timeline-reset-live' button. Clicking reset-live removes button. (4) WeatherLayersPanel shows 4 toggles: toggle-clouds, toggle-rain, toggle-wind, toggle-trajectory. Trajet default ON. (5) Internal frame-slider inside WeatherLayersPanel is HIDDEN when timelineDriven=true (frame-slider selector returned null, confirming timelineDriven works). (6) Clouds/Rain mutual exclusivity confirmed via toggle class observation. (7) Radius slider (20-70), push toggles and bulletin PDF link present and functional. (8) /historique page loads and renders 170+ chart elements. Test command: REACT_APP_BACKEND_URL=https://storm-monitor-20km.preview.emergentagent.com python -m pytest backend/tests/test_storm_tracker.py -v
